objective.text: Assign one item to multiple groups when a groupBy callback returns several group keys.

difficulty.rationale: Interpret an array-valued grouping callback as several memberships, not a serialized single key.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: How many records appear in the author and editor groups?

options.rationale: This assumes only the first role in each callback result is used.

options.text: An error because groupBy callbacks must always return a scalar key
options.rationale: The callback can return multiple keys to place an item into several groups.
